arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/flake8/style_guide.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('flake8.style_guide')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from argparse import Namespace
options=Namespace(select=None,extend_select=['F4'],ignore=[],extend_ignore=[],extended_default_select=['E'],extended_default_ignore=[],per_file_ignores=[])
from flake8.style_guide import DecisionEngine,Selected,Ignored
engine=DecisionEngine(options)
values=[engine.was_selected(code) for code in ['F401','E201','Z999']]
print('selection_levels',values)
assert values==[Selected.Explicitly,Selected.Implicitly,Ignored.Implicitly]
